Sebastian points out Gold's Gym, mentioning he doesn't have a membership.
Sebastian jokes that he doesn't need a gym because of the workout he's getting from hiking.

characterInteraction.description: Sebastian speaks directly to the viewer.

activities.description: Sebastian is back at the trailhead.
Sebastian points out Old Manchester Road.
Sebastian points out Page Lumber and discusses the future bridge over Route 55.
Sebastian explains that the bridge will connect the Duchess County Rail Trail across Route 55, allowing for a continuous trail from New Paltz to Hopewell Junction.

characterInteraction.description: Sebastian speaks directly to the viewer, sharing information about the trail's development.

Sebastian points out Page Lumber and the location of the future Route 55 bridge.
Sebastian explains the bridge's role in connecting the entire trail.
Sebastian mentions that construction is supposed to begin in 2012.
